internal_evidence.finding: RAE-8.8 r2 / 04234efd... remained canonical parent during run.
Accepted ClayGraph remains G0 seed; fixed two-hop activation and future research list include time decay, conflict preservation and learned weighting.
Naive salience can become a self-confirming attractor; exact lookups can be harmed by graph propagation, motivating BYPASS/capped propagation.
Fast/slow bindings, provenance diversity, conflict/inhibition, source-echo penalties and reversible promotion are already candidate semantics; not production validated.
Current graph edge schema has scalar weight/confidence/provenance/admissibility but no explicit context-bound fast/slow version interval or reversal-promotion receipt.
Hyperrelations and projection/selection/receiver receipts exist; derived topology remains non-authoritative.
Loop topology should be epoch-bound and intervention-observable; repeated loop use never promotes truth.
Recurrence state requires trajectory/residual/capacity context; recurrence/re-entry do not imply authority or emergence.
Common-driver/source confounds and higher-order failure modes require conditioned controls, lesion/rescue, shuffle and OOD before causal promotion.
Fast routing is separated from slower learning-credit and live-topology promotion; candidate/intent/permit/live-ref identities remain distinct.
Replay integrity and selection integrity are separate; derivation/version identity and UNKNOWN dependency closure must be explicit.

external_evidence.use: Supports event-time-aware dynamic graph state as a technical baseline; does not validate RAB.

external_evidence.use: Provides a change-point family counterbaseline for online reversal detection; RAB is not claimed superior without target comparison.

external_evidence.ref: Knowledge Poisoning Attacks to Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation, arXiv:2508.04276
external_evidence.use: Motivates explicit adversarial/source-corruption controls; graph connectivity and repetition are not self-authenticating.
Supports preserving source-level provenance in multi-source graph construction; does not establish the selected diversity threshold.

synthetic_evidence.finding: RAB strongly reduced false reversal under a single correlated echo family while retaining near-EMA true reversal lag at 5-10% noise; at 20% noise a small adaptation/accuracy cost appeared.

Minimum provenance-family diversity k=3-4 produced most echo robustness with little true-reversal lag cost in this constructed setting; k=5 began measurable adaptation penalty. Threshold is not production-calibrated.

negative_results: RAB did not outperform a simple context-aware EMA on ordinary context bifurcation; context identity explains most of that task.
At 20% observation noise RAB had lower true-reversal accuracy and slightly greater lag than context-aware EMA.
The mechanism benchmark is hand-constructed and uses synthetic source-family identities; it is not live FRANK or target-Qwen evidence.
No claim that k=3 or k=4 is globally optimal is supported.
No accepted ClayGraph generation or canonical scientific revision is justified.
